=== 27031 Exhibit A - Buildings in Scope.xlsx :: sheet "Notes" (11 rows) ===
Exhibit A – Notes |
1. | Building numbers are University facility numbers as shown in the FY2026 Facilities Inventory and Space Report.
2. | Gross Sq Ft (Column D) is taken from the facilities inventory and includes all floors. Cleanable Sq Ft (Column E) excludes mechanical, electrical and telecommunications rooms, shafts, unconditioned storage, and areas cleaned by others (laboratory benches, food service kitchens, teaching kitchens, hangar bays, athletic arena floors).
3. | Residence halls (Buildings 1102 Ozark Hall, 1104 Cedar Hall, 1106 Juniper Hall and 1108 Sycamore Suites): Cleanable Sq Ft includes lobbies, lounges, corridors, laundry rooms and community restrooms only. Student rooms and suite bathrooms are cleaned by residents. Buildings 1110 Maple Apartments and 1120 Honors College House are not residence halls and are serviced on the days shown in Column H.
4. | Restroom Fixtures = water closets + urinals + lavatories in areas serviced by the Contractor. Showers are not counted.
5. | Service Days/Week: 5 = Monday–Friday; 6 = Monday–Saturday; 7 = daily including weekends; 3 = Monday, Wednesday and Friday; 2 = Tuesday and Thursday; 1 = once per week; 0 = no routine service (building listed for information only).
6. | Building 0030 Ballman Speer is used for storage and receives no custodial service. It is listed for information only.
7. | Building 1112 University Dining Commons: custodial service covers the dining room, restrooms and public corridors only. Kitchen, serving lines and dish room are cleaned by the food service contractor.
8. | Building 3301 Aviation Technology Center: hangar bays are swept by University staff and are excluded from Cleanable Sq Ft.
9. | APPA Level 2 applies to all buildings unless the Remarks column states otherwise.
10. | The TOTAL row is a simple sum of every row on the Exhibit A tab, including buildings listed for information only. Refer to the RFP document and any addenda for changes to this exhibit.
